step1_analysis.description: Generates multiple DC bias voltages (VREF, VBIAS1, VBIAS2, VBIAS3) from a single reference current (IBIAS) using current mirrors and a wide-swing PMOS cascode structure.

paper_reference.title: A 100-Mb/s 2.8-V CMOS Current-Mode Analog Viterbi Decoder

DC_Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias generator.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on an assumed 50uA reference current and 1.8V supply.

VREF_Voltage.description: DC bias voltage for simple PMOS mirrors.

VBIAS1_Voltage.description: DC bias voltage for NMOS mirrors.

VBIAS2_Voltage.description: DC bias voltage for the top PMOS in the cascode.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM4 needs Vds > Vov (~0.19V) to sink 50uA. XM9 is forced into linear region, pulling N7 to VDD, allowing XM10 to source 50uA. VBIAS2 settles near 0.3V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Headroom balance in the cascode structure when all devices are equally sized.

VBIAS3_Voltage.description: DC bias voltage for the bottom PMOS in the cascode.

sky130_expected.calculation: Same as VREF, standard PMOS diode drop at 50uA.

PSRR_VBIAS1.description: Power Supply Rejection Ratio at VBIAS1.

sky130_expected.calculation: Typical simple mirror PSRR is roughly 20*log10(1 / (gm * ro)).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard rejection for a diode-connected load driven by a cascode.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC bias voltages, power consumption, and PSRR of the bias generator.
